none: PAS LIN-A884E7: Roman silver TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman 'TOT' ring dating to the second or third century AD. The ring has a circular bezel bearing the inscription TOT, an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Toutatis. The shoulders of the ring are triangular and decorated with an incised linear perimeter and two circles in each corner near the bezel. The hoop is oval in plan and a slender D-shape in cross-section. The internal diameter of the hoop measures 17mm x 15mm. The bezel measures 7mm in diameter. Treasure reference number 2011 T750. Silver rings bearing the inscription TOT are well known finds from the East Midlands, especially in Lincolnshire
